summary: Full-stack test of Anez Creative pricelist. Backend booking CRUD (8 pytest cases incl. sort + missing-name + invalid event_type) all PASS. Frontend hero tagline, WA number 6285766564437 across all 18 wa.me anchors (no legacy 6282291840341 anywhere), Instagram links to anez.creative (nav, section, feed x6, footer), gallery filter counts 26/11/07/08 all correct, lightbox counter wraps inside filter set, booking form persists to Mongo (verified via GET /api/bookings), admin gate rejects bad key/accepts anez2026, status change persists across reload, mobile nav opens with WA + booking links.

issues: Console warning: input[pattern] uses regex '[0-9+\s-]{9,20}' which Chrome rejects under the /v flag (Invalid character class). Cosmetic — form still submits; recommend escaping the dash or removing the pattern.
Uses native browser date picker (input type=date) rather than a themed shadcn Calendar — acceptable but visually inconsistent with dark luxury theme.

action_items: (optional) Fix booking-whatsapp input pattern regex: '[0-9+\s-]{9,20}' -> '[0-9+\s\-]{9,20}' to silence Chrome console error.
(optional) Replace native date input with shadcn Calendar for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend routers/bookings.py: require_admin uses os.environ['ADMIN_KEY'] at call-time — OK, but a KeyError would surface as 500; consider os.environ.get with a startup guard.
GET /bookings has no pagination limit besides to_list(1000) — fine for MVP but note for scale.

Frontend nav CTA buttons (hero-pricelist-cta, hero-form-cta) render as <button> without href; scroll works via onClick — fine, but requirement said 'scrolls to #paket' which is satisfied programmatically, not via anchor href.
test_credentials: Admin key: anez2026 (header X-Admin-Key). No user login.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of bookings via pytest + one 'TEST Klien E2E' via frontend form; admin list now shows 20 rows / 7 baru.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows verified. Admin gate uses sessionStorage; status change on first row was set to 'dihubungi' and persisted. Public URL: https://creative-pricelist.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend base is same origin /api. Frontend uses relative /api (no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Gallery counts and lightbox verified.
